name: NGC 7329 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7329, a barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: n7329-hubble
story: A stellar whirlpool with a bar of stars across its center. Hubble studied it for a program designed to refine the Hubble constant, the rate at which the universe is expanding.

claims.text: NGC 7329 is a barred spiral galaxy, a 'stellar whirlpool'
NGC 7329 is a spiral galaxy imaged by Hubble's WFC3
Observed as part of a program designed to help refine the Hubble Constant
